blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The number of attention heads in a transformer is usually set by convention or grid search. We test a simple heuristic for setting it in advance: estimate the intrinsic dimension of token representations without labels, and use roughly that many heads. We estimate intrinsic dimension with a nested-dropout VAE trained on DistilBERT embeddings of WikiText-2, choosing the KL weight at the knee of the VAE's rate-distortion curve rather than by hand. This gives $k^*=9.2$ (95% CI [8.6, 9.8]). In a small 4-layer transformer trained from scratch, 10 heads and 32 heads are statistically equivalent on SST-2 and on MRPC (paired TOST over 10 seeds, $\pm1$ point margin), with 69% fewer attention parameters for the 10-head model. Training 10 heads from the start also slightly outperforms training 32 heads and pruning to 10 (0.6 points, $p=0.008$). The evidence is narrow: two classification tasks, one small architecture, no pretrained models, and no formal link between intrinsic dimension and head count. We present the result as a practical heuristic worth testing at larger scale, not as a general principle.
blocks.zh: 变压器中的注意头数通常通过常规或网格搜索设定. 我们测试一种简单的heuristic 预先设置它: 估计象征表示的内在维度 没有标签, 并使用大致那么多的头。 我们用一个嵌入WikiText 2 的嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式嵌入式VAE来估计内在维基维度,选择VAE的速率扭曲曲线膝盖上的KL重量,而不是用手. 这相当于9.2 美元(95%CI [8.6, 9.8])。 在从零开始训练的4层小型变压器中,在SST-2和MRPC上,10头和32头在统计学上等同(在10个种子上标注TOST,$\pm1美元点差值),10头模型的注意参数减少69%. 从一开始就培训10名负责人,培训32名负责人的工作也略胜于培训10名负责人(0.6分,0.08美元)。 证据是狭义的:两个分类任务,一个小架构,没有经过事先训练的模型,内在维度和头数之间没有正式的联系. 我们提出这一结果是一种实际的、值得在更大范围内进行测试的热力测试,而不是一项一般原则。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ask why a transformer has 8, 12 or 16 attention heads per layer and the honest answer is usually that a previous model did. Head count is rarely derived from the task. Meanwhile, pruning studies keep finding that many heads in trained models can be removed with little loss ( Michel et al., 2019 ; Voita et al., 2019 ) , which suggests the usual counts are often larger than needed. The standard response is to train a large model and prune it afterwards. We ask whether the count can instead be chosen before training, from a cheap property of the data.
blocks.zh: 问为什么一个变压器每层有8个12个或16个注意头,诚实的答案通常是之前的模型有. 头数很少来自任务. 同时,普鲁克研究不断发现,许多训练有素的模型中的头可以去掉而损失很少(Michel等,2019;Voita等,2019),这表明通常的计数往往大于需要. 标准的反应是训练出一个大型模型,然后把它磨成一团. 我们询问是否可以在培训前从数据的一个廉价属性中选择这一数目。

blocks.en: The property we use is intrinsic dimension: roughly, the number of independent directions along which the representations actually vary. Section 3 explains why this might bear on head count and where the analogy breaks down. In short, we treat it as a hypothesis with a testable prediction: a model with about k ∗ k^{*} heads should do as well as one with many more.
blocks.zh: 我们使用的财产是内在的维度:大致来说,各种表述方式实际上各不相同的独立方向的数目。 第3节解释了为什么这可能会影响人头计算以及类比的分解。 简言之,我们用一个可测试的预测把它当作一个假说:一个有大约k * 的模型以及一个有许多其他的模型应该做。

blocks.en: We test that prediction at small scale. Our contributions are: • A label-free procedure for estimating a head count: a nested-dropout VAE on token embeddings, an elbow detector suited to the convex spectra such VAEs produce, and a rule for choosing the VAE’s KL weight from its own rate–distortion curve. Applied to DistilBERT embeddings of WikiText-2, it gives k ∗ = 9.2 k^{*}=9.2 . • A paired-seed comparison showing that 10 heads match 32 heads on SST-2 and MRPC (TOST equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 accuracy point) in a 4-layer transformer trained from scratch, with 69% fewer attention parameters. • A comparison with reactive pruning: training 10 heads from the start slightly but consistently beats training 32 heads and pruning to 10.
blocks.zh: 我们小规模地测试这一预测。 我们的贡献是 : — — 估计人头数的无标签程序:一个嵌入符上嵌入的嵌入式投放VAE,一个适合这种VAE所出对流光谱的肘部探测器,以及一个从自己的速率-扭曲曲线中选择VAE的KL分量的规则。 应用到 DistilBERT 嵌入了 Wikitext 2, 它给出 k * = 9.2 k^{*}= 9.2. ^ 成对种子比较显示,在从零开始训练的四层变压器中,有10个头与SST-2和MRPC(±1\pm 1精确点内的TOST等同)上的32个头相匹配,注意度参数减少69%. 二. 支助 与反应性打压的比较:从一开始就训练出10个头,但始终将训练出32个头,打出10个头。

blocks.en: A label-free procedure for estimating a head count: a nested-dropout VAE on token embeddings, an elbow detector suited to the convex spectra such VAEs produce, and a rule for choosing the VAE’s KL weight from its own rate–distortion curve. Applied to DistilBERT embeddings of WikiText-2, it gives k ∗ = 9.2 k^{*}=9.2 .

blocks.en: The claims are modest. We do not derive head count from intrinsic dimension, and two small tasks with one architecture do not establish a general rule. Section 6 lists what would be needed to do so.
blocks.zh: 索赔数额不大。 我们不从内在的维度中得出头数,两个带有一个架构的小任务不能确立通则. 第6节列出了这样做所需的条件。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Michel et al. (2019) showed that most heads in trained transformers can be removed at test time with small accuracy loss, using an importance score based on the effect of masking each head. Voita et al. (2019) found that a few specialized heads do most of the work and pruned the rest during training. Both start from a fixed, large head count and reduce it. We instead choose the count before training and compare against this kind of pruning directly.
blocks.zh: Michel等 (2019年)显示,训练有素的变压器中的大多数头部可以在测试时被去除而失去的精度很小,根据每个头部被遮住的效果使用一个分量. Voita等 (2019年)发现少数专业头目做大部分工作,其余在训练期间被打压. 两者都从固定的,大头数开始并减少. 我们选择了训练前的计数, 和这种直接的挤压作比较。

blocks.en: Neural representations typically occupy far fewer dimensions than their ambient size. Ansuini et al. (2019) measured this across layers of vision networks with the TwoNN estimator ( Facco et al., 2017 ) , and Aghajanyan et al. (2021) showed that fine-tuning language models needs only a low-dimensional subspace of parameter updates. These works use intrinsic dimension to describe trained models; we try to use it to configure one.
blocks.zh: 神经分泌的维度通常远低于其环境大小。 Ansuini等人(2019年)用TwoNN的预测器(Facco等人,2017年)和Aghajanyan等人(2021年)测量了这个跨多层的视觉网络,显示微调语言模型只需要一个参数更新的低维子空间. 这些作品使用内在维度来描述训练有素的模型;我们尝试用它来配置一个模型.

blocks.en: Nested dropout ( Rippel et al., 2014 ) trains an autoencoder so that its latent dimensions are ordered by importance, which makes it possible to read off how many dimensions are in use from a single model. We combine it with the variational autoencoder ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ) and treat the KL weight, as in β \beta -VAE ( Higgins et al., 2017 ) , as a rate–distortion knob. For locating elbows we start from the Kneedle method ( Satopää et al., 2011 ) .
blocks.zh: 辍学 (Rippel等,2014年) 培训自定义编码器,以便其潜在尺寸按重要性排序,从而有可能从单一模型中读取使用中有多少个尺寸。 我们把它与可变自编码器(Kingma and Welling, 2014)结合,并将KL的重量,如β\βa-VAE(Higgins等人,2017年),作为速率-扭曲克诺布处理. 关于确定肘部的位置,我们从克奈特方法开始(Satopää等,2011年)。

blocks.en: 3 Why Intrinsic Dimension Might Bear on Head Count
blocks.zh: 3 为何头部计数时有内在尺寸

blocks.en: Each attention head projects tokens into its own small subspace (16 dimensions in our models) and computes a separate attention pattern there. More heads let a layer track more token-to-token relations in parallel, at a parameter cost that grows linearly with the head count. The question is how many of these parallel views a task can actually use.
blocks.zh: 每个注意头将符号投射到自己的小子空间(我们模型中的16个维度)并计算出一个单独的注意模式. 更多头部让一层跟踪更多的符与符的关系平行地,其参数成本随着头数的线性增长. 问题是,一项任务可以实际利用多少这些平行观点。

blocks.en: Our working hypothesis is that this number is limited by how many independent directions of variation the token representations have. If the embeddings vary along about k k independent factors, a layer with far more than k k heads has little new to attend to with the extra ones, and they should end up redundant or unused. That would be consistent with how much trained models can be pruned. Under this hypothesis, an estimate k ∗ k^{*} of intrinsic dimension suggests a head count, and setting the count near k ∗ k^{*} should cost little accuracy compared with a much larger default.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作假设是,这一数目受到象征性表述有多少独立变化方向的限制。 如果嵌入物随大约k k 独立因子而异,那么一个比 k k 个头还多的地层就没有什么新内容可以和额外的地层一起处理,它们最终应该成为冗余或未使用. 这与有多少训练有素的模型可以使用是一致的。 在这个假设下,一个内在维度的估计k * k^{*}表示一个人头计数,与一个大得多的默认值相比,在k * k^{*}附近设置计数成本应该很小.

blocks.en: This is an analogy, not a derivation, and it has obvious gaps. A head is not tied to a single latent dimension. Deeper layers see transformed representations, not the input embeddings. And nothing guarantees that k ∗ k^{*} is a tight bound rather than a loose one. We therefore treat the hypothesis only as a source of a testable prediction: about k ∗ k^{*} heads should match a much larger count. Its practical appeal is that k ∗ k^{*} can be estimated once per domain, without labels and before any classifier is trained.
blocks.zh: 这是一种类比,而不是推论,它有明显的漏洞。 头不是与一个潜在的维相接 更深层可见被改变的表示,而不是输入嵌入. 没有什么能保证k*k^{*}是一个紧密的束缚而不是松散的束缚. 因此,我们只将这一假设视为一个可验证的预测来源:大约k * 个个头应该比得上一个大得多的计数。 其实际吸引力是,k * k^{*}可以每域一一估算,没有标签,在任何分类器训练之前.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Estimating k ∗ k^{*} with a nested-dropout VAE
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 估计 k * k 与 巢中空出 VAE

blocks.en: We pass passages from the WikiText-2 training split ( Merity et al., 2017 ) through a frozen, pretrained distilbert-base-uncased ( Sanh et al., 2019 ) and take the final-layer hidden states, skipping lines shorter than 20 characters, truncating at 128 tokens and dropping the [CLS] and [SEP] positions. We keep the first 60,000 token vectors (768-dimensional) and standardize each dimension. These embeddings come from neither downstream task, so the estimate does not depend on SST-2 or MRPC.
blocks.zh: 由维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中的相关条目: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库 维基文库中相关的原始文献 维基文库中相关的原始文献: 维基文库中, 维基文库 我们保留了前6万个符号向量(768维),并使每个维度标准化. 这些嵌入物既不来自下游任务,因此估计并不依赖于SST-2或MRPC.

blocks.en: The VAE encoder maps each 768-dimensional vector through layers of 512 and 256 units (each with LayerNorm and GELU) to the mean and log-variance of a 64-dimensional latent code; the decoder mirrors it. During training, nested dropout ( Rippel et al., 2014 ) samples m m uniformly from { 1 , … , 64 } \{1,\dots,64\} at each step and zeroes latent dimensions m + 1 m{+}1 to 64 64 . Early dimensions are therefore always in use and later ones rarely, so the trained model orders its dimensions by importance. Training details are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: VAE编码器将每个768维向量通过512和256个单元的地层(每个单元都与LayerNorm和GELU)映射到64维潜码的平均值和日志变量;解码器反射出. 在训练期间,巢出水(Rippel等,2014年)样本为:从{1、.、64}到{1、.dots、64},每步均为0;潜入维度为:m+1 m_1至64。 因此,早期的维度总是在使用,后来的维度也很少使用,因此经过培训的模型按重要性来排序其维度. 培训详情见附录B。

blocks.en: After training, we compute the variance of each latent mean across a held-out 10% of the embeddings and sort these variances in decreasing order. The resulting spectrum drops steeply and then flattens. We take its elbow as the number of active dimensions: after normalizing both axes to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , the elbow is the point furthest below the straight line joining the first and last points. Because the spectrum is convex, this is the correct side of the line; measuring distance above it, as the concave-curve version of Kneedle does, returns an endpoint instead. Appendix A.2 shows this with synthetic spectra.
blocks.zh: 训练结束后,我们计算出10%的嵌入物中 每一个潜在值的差异 并按下降顺序排序这些差异 由此产生的光谱会陡起而后平起而去. 我们把它的肘作为活度维数:在将两轴都正常化到 [0, 1] [0,1]后,肘是正线下最远的点与第一和最后点相接. 由于光谱是凸起的,这是线的正确一面;测量其上方的相距,正如相距-曲线版本克奈特尔所做的那样,返回一个终点取而代之. 附录A.2用合成光谱显示这一点.

blocks.en: The elbow depends strongly on the KL weight β \beta : stronger regularization switches off more latent dimensions. Rather than picking β \beta by hand, we train the VAE at ten values, β ∈ { 0.1 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 8 } \beta\in\{0.1,0.25,0.5,1,2,3,4,5,6,8\} , with five seeds each, and record the held-out reconstruction loss. Plotting mean loss against β \beta traces a rate–distortion curve, and we take β ∗ \beta^{*} at its knee, found with the same line-distance rule (both axes min–max normalized, β \beta on a linear scale). The estimate k ∗ k^{*} is the mean elbow across seeds at β ∗ \beta^{*} . Nothing in this procedure looks at the downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 肘部严重依赖KL重量β \β: 更强的正则性能切换出更潜在的维度。 我们不是用手来挑选β\β,而是用十个值来训练VAE,β { { 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8}\β\in 0. 1,0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5,6, 8\}, 每人有5个种子,记录被搁置重建的损失. 对β\β的刻出平均损失 跟踪一个速率-扭曲曲线, 我们用β *\β 的膝盖, 发现相同的线程规则( 双轴分数- max 正常,β\β 以线性尺度)。 估计的k ∗为β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β β 这一程序没有考虑下游任务。

blocks.en: 4.2 Downstream comparison: 10 heads versus 32
blocks.zh: 4.2 下游比较:10个头与32个头

blocks.en: SST-2 ( Socher et al., 2013 ) sentiment classification (67,349 training and 872 validation sentences) and MRPC ( Dolan and Brockett, 2005 ) paraphrase detection from GLUE ( Wang et al., 2019 ) (3,668 training and 408 validation sentence pairs). Text is tokenized with the bert-base-uncased tokenizer to at most 128 tokens; MRPC pairs are encoded jointly as [CLS] sentence 1 [SEP] sentence 2 [SEP] .
blocks.zh: SST-2(Socher等,2013年)情绪分类(67,349个培训和872个验证句)和MRPC(Dolan和Brockett,2005年)从GLUE(Wang等,2019年)解说检测(3,668个培训和408个验证句对). 文本以bert-base-uncased sorderizer为标志,最多为128个符;MRPC对被联合编码为[CLS]句 [SEP]句 [SEP].

blocks.en: A 4-layer transformer encoder ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) trained from scratch, with model dimension 128, feed-forward dimension 512 and 16 dimensions per head. Classification uses the [CLS] position. Only the number of heads k k differs between configurations, so the attention projection width is 16 ​ k 16k : 160 for k = 10 k=10 and 512 for k = 32 k=32 . The two models have 4,788,418 and 5,509,314 parameters in total, and 327,680 and 1,048,576 attention parameters, a 69% reduction in attention parameters for k = 10 k=10 .
blocks.zh: 从零开始训练出4层变压器编码器(Vaswani等,2017年),型号为128,饲料向前的尺寸为512,每头有16个尺寸. 分类使用[CLS]位置. 只有头kk的数量在配置上有所不同,所以注意力投放宽度为16克16克:160为k=10克10,512为k=32克32. 这两个模型共有4,788,418和5,509,314个参数,并有327,680和1,048,576个注意参数,K=10克=10个注意参数减少69%.

blocks.en: We train both configurations with the same 10 random seeds. For a given seed, both see identical data order (each run has its own seeded data loader) and differ only in head count. We test the paired accuracy differences in two ways: a two-sided paired t t -test for a difference, and two one-sided tests (TOST, Lakens, 2017 ) for equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 accuracy point. We fixed this margin before running the comparison. k = 10 k=10 was fixed before these experiments (Appendix A.3 gives its history) and was used unchanged on MRPC, which therefore serves as an out-of-sample check. MRPC needed different optimization settings from SST-2 because it is about 18 times smaller (Appendix A.4 ); both head counts always share the same settings.
blocks.zh: 我们用同样的10个随机种子来训练两种配置. 对于给定的种子,两者都参见相同的数据顺序(每个运行都有自己的种子数据加载器),仅在头数上有所不同. 我们通过两种方式测试对等的精度差异:一是双相对t-测试差;二是单相测试(TOST, Lakens, 2017)测试等效于±1\pm 1的精度点. 在进行对比之前,我们确定了这个比值。 k = 10 k = 10在这些实验前被固定(附录A.3给出其历史),在MRPC上使用时未作任何修改,因此用作外样检查. MRPC需要与SST-2不同的优化设置,因为它的大小约为18倍(Appendix A.4);两个头数总是共享相同的设置.

blocks.en: 4.3 Pruning baseline
blocks.zh: 4.3 预测基线

blocks.en: To compare prospective selection with the usual alternative, for each of the same 10 seeds we train a 32-head model on SST-2, score each head by how much masking it increases validation loss ( Michel et al., 2019 ) , keep the 10 highest-scoring heads in each layer, and build a genuinely smaller model by slicing out their weights. We checked that this sliced model reproduces the masked 32-head model up to floating-point rounding (largest difference below 10 − 6 10^{-6} over five random trials). The pruned model is then fine-tuned for up to 5 epochs at a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh: 将未来选择与通常选择相比较, 对于同样的10个种子, 我们在SST-2上训练一个32个头的模型, 每头的分数是多少掩盖会增加验证损失(Michel等人, 2019年), 我们检查过,这个被切开的模型复制了被蒙住的32个头的模型,直到浮点圆(在5个随机试验中,最大的差异低于10 - 6 10 - 6). 后以2×10-5 2\times 10×5}的学习率对被打磨的模型进行微调,最多可达5个纪元.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 The VAE estimate
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 VAE 估计数

blocks.en: Figure 1 and Table 1 show the sweep. Held-out reconstruction loss rises steadily with β \beta while the elbow falls from 34 active dimensions at β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 to about 5 at β = 8 \beta=8 , so the estimate depends heavily on the KL weight and a single hand-picked value would be close to arbitrary. The knee of the loss curve is at β ∗ = 4 \beta^{*}=4 , an interior point (its distance from the chord peaks there at 0.222 and falls to zero at both ends). At β ∗ \beta^{*} the elbow is k ∗ = 9.2 k^{*}=9.2 , 95% CI [ 8.6 , 9.8 ] [8.6,9.8] . The values 3, 5 and 6 were added after a first seven-point sweep to check the knee more finely; they left β ∗ \beta^{*} and k ∗ k^{*} unchanged.

blocks.en: 5.2 10 heads versus 32

Table 2 gives the main result. On SST-2 the 10-head model averages 82.13% validation accuracy and the 32-head model 81.95%. The paired difference is not significant ( t = 1.08 t=1.08 , p = 0.31 p=0.31 , Cohen’s d = 0.34 d=0.34 ), and TOST confirms equivalence within one point ( p = 0.0005 p=0.0005 ). On MRPC, with k = 10 k=10 carried over unchanged, the two models reach 70.47% and 70.37% ( t = 0.34 t=0.34 , p = 0.74 p=0.74 , d = 0.11 d=0.11 ), again equivalent ( p = 0.006 p=0.006 ). So in this setting, cutting attention parameters by 69% costs no measurable accuracy on either task.
blocks.zh: 表2提供了主要结果。 在SST-2上,10头模型平均验证精度为82.13%,32头模型为81.95%. 配对的相差不显著(t=1.08t=1.08,p=0.31p=0.31,Cohen's d=0.34 d=0.34),TOST在一分内确认等同(p=0.0005 p=0.0005). 在MRPC上,以k=10克=10的相承未变,两种型号分别达到70.47%和70.37%(t=0.34 t=0.34,p=0.74,d=0.11 d=0.11),再次等同(p=0.006 p=0.006)。 因此,在这个背景下, 将注意力参数削减69% 成本没有可衡量的精确度 任一任务。

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with pruning
blocks.zh: 5.3 与运行的比较

blocks.en: Pruning the trained 32-head models to 10 heads without further training drops accuracy sharply and erratically, to 71.69 % ± 7.04 71.69\%\pm 7.04 (Table 3 ). Fine-tuning recovers most of this, to 81.50 % ± 0.37 81.50\%\pm 0.37 . The 10-head models trained from scratch still do slightly better, by 0.63 points on average ( t = 3.41 t=3.41 , p = 0.008 p=0.008 , d = 1.08 d=1.08 ). The gap is consistent across seeds but small; it also falls inside our ± 1 \pm 1 point equivalence margin (TOST p = 0.039 p=0.039 ). The larger difference is cost. The prospective model never needs a trained 32-head model or a head-scoring pass; the full pruning pipeline took 2.41 GPU-hours for 10 seeds, about as much as all 20 runs of the SST-2 comparison (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 将训练有素的32个头型型号推到10个头型而未经过进一步训练,其精度急剧地和不稳定地下降到71.69% ± 7.04 71.69% ppm 7.04(表3). 微调恢复了大部分,为81.50% ± 0.37 81.50平方公分 0.37。 从零开始训练的10个头型仍然稍好,平均得分0.63分(t = 3.41t = 3.41,p = 0.008 p = 0.008,d = 1.08 d = 1.08),相差相差虽小,但也落在我们的± 1\pm 1等分比分内(TOST p = 0.039 p = 0.039). 更大的差别是成本。 未来型号从不需要训练有素的32个头型或头等分数的通路;整个穿梭管为10个种子用了2.41GPU小时,大约相当于SST-2比较的全部20跑(Appendix C.).

blocks.en: The comparison is if anything tilted toward pruning, because head scores and fine-tuning both used the validation set on which accuracy is reported. We tested only one importance score, on one task.
blocks.zh: 比较的是,如果有东西向螺旋倾斜,因为头分和微调都使用了报告准确性的验证装置。 我们只测试了一个重要分数 一个任务

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: What the experiments support is narrow: for this small model on these two tasks, 10 heads are enough, and choosing 10 up front is at least as good as pruning down to 10. The VAE estimate landing near 10 is encouraging but is a single agreement, not a validation of the method. Several things would be needed before treating the heuristic as reliable.
blocks.zh: 实验的支持是狭义的: 对于这两个任务上的这个小模型,10个头就足够了,选择前方的10个头至少和往下推到10个一样好. VAE估计接近10的着陆情况令人鼓舞,但是一个单一的协议,而不是对该方法的验证. 在将热情视为可靠之前,需要做一些事情。

blocks.en: Section 3 gives an intuition, not a theorem. We have no bound connecting intrinsic dimension to the number of heads a task needs, and no account of why a property of the input embeddings should constrain every layer.
blocks.zh: 第三节给出了直觉,而不是定理. 我们没有将内在层面与任务所需头数联系起来,也没有说明输入嵌入物的属性为何会限制每一层。

blocks.en: We compare only 10 and 32. That shows 10 is sufficient, not that k ∗ k^{*} is the right place to stop. A sweep over roughly 4 to 16 heads with multiple seeds would show where accuracy starts to fall and whether that point tracks k ∗ k^{*} . The same sweep would answer an obvious objection: that a simpler rule, such as trying a few powers of two, would find an equally good count without any VAE.
blocks.zh: 我们只比较10和32。 显示10就足够了, 而不是k *  k是合适的停站地点。 用多颗种子扫描出大约4至16个头,将显示准确度从哪里开始下降,以及该点轨迹是否为k * k 。 同样的打扫会回答一个明显的反对意见:一个简单的规则,比如尝试几个两个权力,会找到一个同样好的计数,而没有任何VAE.

blocks.en: We use one intrinsic-dimension estimator. Others, such as TwoNN ( Facco et al., 2017 ) or PCA explained variance, might give different numbers, and the knee rule for β \beta is one reasonable choice among several (cross-validated likelihood or minimum description length would be alternatives).
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个内在的分化估计器。 其他的,如TwoNN(Facco等人,2017年)或PCA解释差异,可能会给出不同的数字,β\β的膝盖规则是几个人的合理选择(交叉验证的可能性或最小描述长度将是替代品).

blocks.en: All results come from a 4-layer, 128-dimensional transformer trained from scratch on two binary classification tasks. We have not tested pretrained models, larger models, generation, long contexts or tasks that need multi-step reasoning, where head requirements may be quite different.
blocks.zh: 所有结果均出自从零开始训练的4层128维变压器两个二元分级任务. 我们没有测试经过预先训练的模型,更大的模型,生成,需要多步推理的长背景或任务,其中头部要求可能有很大的不同.

blocks.en: One ablation-based importance score on one task. Gradient-based scores ( Michel et al., 2019 ) or pruning during training ( Voita et al., 2019 ) might close the gap.
blocks.zh: 在一项任务上,一个基于淡化的重要性得分。 以渐入为主的分数(Michel等,2019年)或训练期间的打分(Voita等,2019年)可能缩小差距.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We tested whether a label-free estimate of intrinsic dimension can set the number of attention heads before training. In a small transformer, a head count near the estimate matched one more than three times larger on two tasks and slightly beat pruning to the same size. These results are a reason to try the heuristic at a larger scale, with a proper sweep over head counts and comparisons against simpler rules, not a reason to adopt it yet.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了对内在维度的无标签估计是否能够在训练前确定注意头的数量. 在一个小型变压器中,在两个任务上,估计值附近的人头数比两个任务大一倍多一点,并略微将扳平到同样大小。 这些结果是更大规模地尝试高压主义的理由,对头数进行适当扫地,并与更简单的规则进行比较,而不是采用它的理由.

blocks.en: Appendix A Development History
blocks.zh: 附录A 发展史

blocks.en: Several problems surfaced while building this pipeline and changed its results. We record them here because they explain some design choices in the main text.
blocks.zh: 在修建这一管道时出现了一些问题并改变了其结果。 我们在这里记录它们是因为它们解释了主要文本中的一些设计选择。

blocks.en: A.1 Unpaired seeds
blocks.zh: A.1 未种植的种子

blocks.en: In an early version of the SST-2 comparison, both head counts drew data order from the global random number generator after model initialization. Initialization consumes a number of random draws that depends on the head count, so for the same seed the 10-head and 32-head runs saw different batch orders, and the paired test was not actually paired. Every run now has its own seeded data loader, and we confirmed that batch order matches within each seed pair before rerunning all comparisons.
blocks.zh: 在早期版本的SST-2比较中,两个头数在模型初始化后从全球随机数生成器中抽取出数据顺序. 初始化消耗了一些取决于头数的随机抽取,因此对于同种种子,10头和32头跑都看到了不同的分批订单,而配对测试实际上并没有进行对接. 现在每跑都有自己的种子数据加载器,我们确认,在重新运行所有比较之前,每对种子中的批量订单匹配。

blocks.en: A.2 Elbow detection on convex spectra
blocks.zh: A.2 在对流光谱上检测肘

blocks.en: The first elbow detector measured distance above the chord joining the spectrum’s endpoints, which suits concave curves. A variance spectrum from nested dropout is convex, so every interior point lies below the chord and the detector returns an endpoint (or, with noise, a point next to one), chosen by noise rather than by the curve’s shape. We tested this on synthetic spectra. On 15 noiseless convex spectra the original rule returned k = 1 k=1 or k = 64 k=64 every time, and on 260 noisy ones it returned k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 63 , 64 } k\in\{1,2,63,64\} every time. The corrected rule, which measures distance below the chord, recovered the known elbow exactly on all 180 noisy piecewise-linear spectra with elbows between k = 4 k=4 and k = 32 k=32 .
blocks.zh: 第一个肘部探测器测量出比和弦上方的距离加入光谱的端点,这适合相接曲线. 从巢出水的相差谱是凸起的,因此每个内出地点都位于和弦下方,而探测器返回一个由噪声而不是由曲线形状选择的终点(或有噪声的相邻点). 我们在合成光谱上测试过这个。 在15个无噪声的凸起光谱上,原规则每次回克=1克=1或克=64克=64;在260个有噪声的凸起光谱上,每次回克=1,2,63,64克=in 1,2,63,64\}. 校正后的规则测量出和弦下方的相距,在所有180个吵闹的分件-线性光谱上完全恢复了已知的肘部,肘部介于克=4克=4和克=32克=32之间.

blocks.en: A.3 Where k = 10 k=10 came from
blocks.zh: A.3 联合国 k=10克=10出处

blocks.en: k = 10 k=10 was first obtained from an early version of the VAE analysis that used the faulty elbow detector at a hand-picked β = 4 \beta=4 . That number should not be trusted on its own, which is why we later replaced the hand-picked β \beta with the knee rule and fixed the detector. The corrected procedure chooses β ∗ \beta^{*} without reference to the earlier result, happens to land on the same β ∗ = 4 \beta^{*}=4 , and gives k ∗ = 9.2 k^{*}=9.2 . So k = 10 k=10 was fixed before the downstream experiments, but the corrected estimate that supports it came afterwards. We regard the agreement as a modest corroboration, not an independent derivation.
blocks.zh: k = 10 k = 10 最早取自一早期版本的VAE分析,在手取β = 4\β= 4. 这个号码不应该靠自己,这就是为什么我们后来用膝盖规则取代了手取取的β\β并固定了探测器. 校正后的程序选择了β *\β 而不参考更早的结果,碰巧在同一β * = 4\β 4 上着陆,并给出了 k * = 9.2 k^{*}= 9.2 . 所以 k = 10 k = 10 在下游实验前被固定,但支持它的校正后产生的估计. 我们认为,该协定只是一种有限的佐证,而不是一种独立衍生。

blocks.en: A.4 MRPC training settings
blocks.zh: A.4. 保护少数委员会的培训环境

blocks.en: Reusing the SST-2 settings on MRPC made both models predict only the majority class (validation accuracy stuck at 68.4%). The cause was the fixed 500-step warmup, which at batch size 64 covered most of MRPC’s 580–870 training steps. A first fix with weaker regularization (dropout 0.15, weight decay 0.01) avoided the collapse but let both models overfit, and the 32-head model overfit slightly more: its train–validation gap was about 0.7 points larger. Under that setting the paired difference reached p = 0.04 p=0.04 in favor of 10 heads. We did not treat this as a real head-count effect, since it came from unequal overfitting. The final settings (Appendix B ) equalize the gaps and the difference disappears. This suggests head-count comparisons on small datasets should be checked for regularization-driven asymmetries before a difference is reported.
blocks.zh: 在 MRPC 上重用 SST-2 设置使得两个模型只预测了多数类(验证精度卡在68.4%). 原因是固定的500步热身,按批量尺寸64,覆盖了MRPC580-870训练步骤的大部分. 首个规范化较弱的固定点(抛出0.15分,重量衰减0.01分)避免了倒塌,但让两个模型都过度适应,32头模型略为超适应:它的列车-验证差约0.7分. 在该设置下,对等相差为:p=0.04;p=0.04,为10个头。 我们没有将此视为真正的人头计算效应,因为它来自不平等的过度调整。 最终设置(Appendix B)将相差相等,相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相相差相差相差相差相差相差相 这表明,在报告差异之前,应当检查小数据集的人均比较情况,以确定由规范驱动的不对称情况。
